findings.note: Hull is listed as a House coauthor of HB 1670 (author: Leach), relating to a person submitting proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote in Texas. The history shows it was referred to the Elections committee on 2025-03-12. Act is coauthor; date is the referral date shown on the page.

Hull is listed as a House coauthor of HB 892 (author: Cain), relating to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote. The history shows it was referred to the Elections committee on 2025-03-06. Act is coauthor; date is the referral date shown on the page.

Hull is listed as an author (alongside Patterson) of HJR 197, proposing a constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen. The history shows it was referred to the Elections committee on 2025-04-03. Date is the referral date shown on the page.

Hull is listed on HJR 103 (author: Leo Wilson), proposing a constitutional amendment specifying the attorney general's authority to prosecute criminal offenses under the state's election laws. Related election-law item, not about ID or citizenship proof; her exact listed role (coauthor) as shown on the page. Tag: election-law prosecution.
